role: Battery-staleness rules for the connected Polar strap: per-device counters of recording hours since the strap last reported a CHANGED battery %, persisted in UserDefaults.standard, and the 70%-of-spec staleness flag.
types: StrapBatteryUsageTracker: struct (@MainActor) — stateless value built on demand by PolarManager.battery (PolarManager.swift:211); reads/writes counters stored on PolarManager
state: ud:polar.batteryUsage.value.<deviceId> (Int, last reported battery %, standard suite)
ud:polar.batteryUsage.changedAt.<deviceId> (Date of last changed value, standard suite)
ud:polar.batteryUsage.hours.<deviceId> (Double recording hours since change, standard suite)
toplevel: No code outside units; one stored let `manager: PolarManager`.

units.does: Reads value/changedAt/hours for deviceId from UserDefaults.standard and copies them onto manager.batteryLastReportedValue, batteryLastChangedAt and hoursRecordedSinceBatteryChanged (hours clamped to >= 0; missing hours read as 0), then recomputes isBatteryReadingStale from the restored counter (false while no battery level is known), so a previous strap's flag never shows against this one.
units.entry: Called via PolarManager.loadBatteryUsageStateIfNeeded (PolarManager.swift:213) from StrapLinkCoordinator.adoptConnectedDevice on every SDK connected event.

units.does: Writes the manager's three battery counters for deviceId into UserDefaults.standard; nil value/changedAt are skipped (old stored value kept), hours always written.

branches.effect: true: writes value key; false: key left untouched
true: writes changedAt key; false: key left untouched

units.does: Adds `hours` to manager.hoursRecordedSinceBatteryChanged, persists it under the connected strap or, after a drop or disconnect, the strap last connected (lastConnectedDeviceId — the one whose counter is in memory), and recomputes the stale flag. With no strap known at all the hours are dropped with a log line.
units.entry: Via PolarManager.recordRecordingHours (PolarManager.swift:214) from RRCollector+Streaming.swift:177, RRCollector+OvernightGather.swift:100, WorkoutRecorder+Stop.swift:200 at session end.

branches.effect: false: returns silently, hours discarded (comment: >48h treated as telemetry bug); true: continue
false: logs that the hours were not charged (no strap known) and returns; true: increments, persists under that id, recomputes staleness

units.does: Sets manager.isBatteryReadingStale = hoursRecordedSinceBatteryChanged > 0.7 × device spec hours (H10 400 h, Verity 30 h); false when no battery level or no device type.

branches.effect: false: stale flag cleared to false and return; true: flag = hours > 0.7 × spec

units.does: Applies a battery callback from the active device: validates 0...100, sets batteryLevel and lastBatteryUpdateTime; if the value differs from the last reported one, records it, stamps batteryLastChangedAt and zeroes the hours counter; persists and recomputes staleness.
units.entry: Via PolarManager.applyBatteryLevelUpdate (PolarManager.swift:217) from StrapLinkCoordinator.apply .battery event (SDK batteryLevelReceived → StrapEventPump).

branches.effect: false: logs and ignores the callback; true: applied
true: resets hours counter to 0 and stamps changedAt=now; false: counters kept (repeat value on connect)
